# FFI - Norwegian Defence Research Establishment

> > FFI (Forsvarets forskningsinstitutt) is Norway's leading defence research institution, conducting multidisciplinary research in cyber security, autonomy, marine biology, explosives, and multi-domain operations for Forsvaret and NATO.

FFI supports Norwegian defence capabilities through applied research ranging from ICT/cyber security and UAV autonomy to marine mammal protection during naval operations and homemade explosives countermeasures. The institute collaborates with Forsvarsdepartementet, NATO, and Politiets sikkerhetstjeneste (PST) on national security challenges.

## Key Topics

- Defence research (forsvarsforskning)
- ICT and cyber domain
- Visual analytics and situational awareness
- Multi-domain operations
- UAV autonomy and swarm systems
- Marine mammal sonar effects
- Homemade explosives (HME/IED)
- Counter-terrorism
- Big data and machine learning
- Human-machine interaction
- NATO collaboration
- Forsvaret (Norwegian Armed Forces)
- Tactical edge computing
- Intelligence and disinformation
- Arctic and maritime security

## Core Research Areas

- [IKT og cyberdomenet](https://www.ffi.no/forskning/tema/ikt-og-cyberdomenet): ICT and cyber domain research theme at FFI for defense applications
- [Forebygging og håndtering av hjemmelagde eksplosiver](https://www.ffi.no/forskning/prosjekter/forebygging-og-handtering-av-hjemmelagde-eksplosiver): Research project on homemade explosives (HME/IED) for police and defense
- [Simulation of multi-domain operations for experimentation and analysis – requirements and available tools](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/simulation-of-multi-domain-operations-for-experimentation-and-analysis-requirements-and-available-tools): Multi-domain operations simulation requirements and tool evaluation at FFI

## Autonomy and UAV Research

- [Flamingo - a UAV for autonomy research](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/flamingo-a-uav-for-autonomy-research): Flamingo quadcopter UAV platform for swarm autonomy research with Valkyrie
- [Konteinerorkestrering i kampnære IKT-systemer – en innledende studie](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/konteinerorkestrering-i-kampnaere-ikt-systemer-en-innledende-studie): Kubernetes container orchestration for tactical edge computing environments

## Visual Analytics and Data Science

- [Visuell analyse –begrepsbeskrivelse og forskningsfront](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/visuell-analyse-begrepsbeskrivelse-og-forskningsfront): Visual analytics research overview: big data, human-machine interaction
- [Han har visualisert millioneffektar](https://www.ffi.no/jobb-og-karriere/student/sommerjobb-ved-ffi/han-har-visualisert-millioneffektar): Summer intern Jonas visualizes economic impacts of defense presence in Senja

## Marine Mammal and Environmental Research

- [Biological significance of sperm whale responses to sonar: Comparison with anti-predator responses](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/biological-significance-of-sperm-whale-responses-to-sonar-comparison-with-anti-predator-responses): Sperm whale behavioral responses to naval sonar vs killer whale playback
- [Eksperiment i Lofoten i sommer: Forskere skal finne ut hva bardehvalen hører](https://www.ffi.no/aktuelt/nyheter/eksperiment-i-lofoten-i-sommer-forskere-skal-finne-ut-hva-bardehvalen-horer): Lofoten experiment by Petter Kvadsheim to study baleen whale hearing
- [Evaluation of Fisheries Sonar for Whale Detection in Relation to Seismic Survey Operations](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/evaluation-of-fisheries-sonar-for-whale-detection-in-relation-to-seismic-survey-operations): Fisheries sonar evaluation for whale detection during seismic surveys
- [Accelerated global glacier mass loss in the early twenty-first century](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/accelerated-global-glacier-mass-loss-in-the-early-twenty-first-century): Global glacier mass loss acceleration 2000-2019 impacts sea-level rise
- [Challenges of Labelling Unknown Seabed Munition Dumpsites from Acoustic and Optical Surveys: A Case Study at Skagerrak](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/challenges-of-labelling-unknown-seabed-munition-dumpsites-from-acoustic-and-optical-surveys-a-case-study-at-skagerrak): UXO labelling methodology using SAS and optical surveys in Skagerrak

## Security and Intelligence Analysis

- [Når «desinformasjon» skjuler det virkelige problemet](https://www.ffi.no/aktuelt/blogg/nar-desinformasjon-skjuler-det-virkelige-problemet): Eskil Sivertsen on how 'disinformation' term obscures influence complexity
- [– Al-Qaida kommer tilbake](https://www.ffi.no/aktuelt/podkaster/15--al-qaida-kommer-tilbake): Anne Stenersen on al-Qaida's resurgence in Afghanistan and Middle East
- [Vertslangsstøtte – hva er Norges rolle som alliert?](https://www.ffi.no/aktuelt/podkaster/vertslandsstotte--hva-er-norges-rolle-som-alliert): Norway's host nation support role from Trident Juncture to NATO concept

## Personnel and Operational Research

- [Det interne arbeidsmarkedet i Forsvaret – stillingsbytter blant militært personell](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/det-interne-arbeidsmarkedet-i-forsvaret-stillingsbytter-blant-militaert-personell): Analysis of job rotation patterns among military personnel 2013-2023
- [Slik har FFI testet SAFEgaiter](https://www.ffi.no/aktuelt/nyheter/slik-har-ffi-testet-safegaiter): FFI testing of SAFEgaiter buffs for Ukraine donation and tear gas protection
- [Her skal Norge skyte opp sine egne satellitter](https://www.ffi.no/aktuelt/nyheter/her-skal-norge-skyte-opp-sine-egne-satellitter): Andøya Spaceport construction for Norwegian small satellite launches

## Optional

- [Personvernerklæring for bruk av FFIs nettsted](https://www.ffi.no/om-ffi/personvernerklaering): FFI privacy policy: personal data, cookies, GDPR compliance on ffi.no
- [The stabilising effect by a novel cable cerclage configuration in long cephalomedullary nailing of subtrochanteric fractures with a posteromedial wedge](https://www.ffi.no/publikasjoner/arkiv/the-stabilising-effect-by-a-novel-cable-cerclage-configuration-in-long-cephalomedullary-nailing-of-subtrochanteric-fractures-with-a-posteromedial-wedge): Figure-of-8 cerclage improves stability in subtrochanteric fracture fixation
